data.title: 新条茜 · 海边的怪兽沙堡
data.description: 【城市海滨沙滩·正午】茜穿着淡紫泳装蹲在沙堡旁，用贝壳给一只小怪兽沙雕做眼睛；她完成后将承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头，红色眼睛里映着阳光和海水，笑容比任何社交场合都更自然。
data.location: quiet city beach away from the crowds
data.action: 沙滩上用贝壳给怪兽沙雕装眼睛，完成后把承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头自然微笑
data.lighting: strong noon sun with warm sand bounce
data.mood: 把孤独做成可以分享的沙堡
data.promptProse: Crouched beside the sandcastle, Akane gently pushes the board bearing her finished monster sand sculpture toward the viewer, shell eyes in place; sun and sand-reflected light brighten her smile.
data.animaCaption: She pushes the sculpture's board gently toward the viewer beside the sandcastle.
